facts.fact: The execution block is the wood-yard chopping stump, scrubbed pale, set in the main court; Rema's court-side objection is entered by Rema herself in writing since Ittan's clerk is held.
facts.why: needed because the outline's 'block' needs a physical form and a recorder of the objection.

facts.fact: When Devan scrapes his knuckle on the kalari pit wall, a thin welt appears on the back of Neela's right knuckle through the wound-share.
facts.why: needed because the shared-wound rule is live and gives her a reason to go down to the pit.

facts.fact: Rema shuts herself in the south range with the tally chest from noon; her sitting opens at lamp-lighting on the day of the execution, after the escort has left on foot by the goat path.
facts.why: needed because the outline has the escort leave at dusk and Rema set the second writ case on the table that evening.

facts.fact: Neela and Devan spar to two light touches with no marma. Neela scores the first on a guard Devan deliberately left open on the left, then the second on her own by earning it. Devan keeps her bandaged left hand out of the line and moves the pit lamp away from it.
facts.why: needed because the outline requires a spar in which she takes a point and he lets her inside his guard.

facts.fact: Neela smells old nightbark on all four escort and reads them as guild hunters with forcing-resin come for her, because her name is on the crown closing writ.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires her guess about the escort; Devan's rival guess is the queen's standing company.

facts.fact: First Guard says 'It passes' to Neela about her split nails at the padippura at dusk; Muthu does not appear to hear.
facts.why: needed because the outline's closing beat for the escort.
